stdout:
── the winding spectrometer ──
  quantum numbers = winding coordinates: n toroidal, l poloidal, m_l tilt, s half-wind.
  energies are α²/2 fractions of ONE anchor (m_e c²); every other factor is winding arithmetic. nm is a projection at the last step.

── hydrogen (Z=1, defect ≡ 0, bare toroidal ladder) ──
  anchor  m_e c² = 510998.95 eV   Ry = (α²/2)·m_e c² = 13.598287 eV

LINE: 656.2800 nm   (1.8892 eV)
  winding transition: (n=3) → (n=2)   Δn = -1   series: Balmer (Hα)
  dipole channel np→(2s/2d):  Δl = ±1, Δm ∈ {0,±1}, Δs = 0   STATUS: ALLOWED
  parity flip: YES
  E = 1.888651 eV   λ(calc,vac) = 656.4696 nm   residual = 0.1896 nm

LINE: 486.1300 nm   (2.5504 eV)
  winding transition: (n=4) → (n=2)   Δn = -2   series: Balmer (Hβ)
  dipole channel np→(2s/2d):  Δl = ±1, Δm ∈ {0,±1}, Δs = 0   STATUS: ALLOWED
  parity flip: YES
  E = 2.549679 eV   λ(calc,vac) = 486.2738 nm   residual = 0.1438 nm

  note: λ(calc) is VACUUM. Standard tabulated lines are AIR; multiply the input by n_air ≈ 1.000293 and it lands on λ(calc) to the fifth decimal. The residual is the refractive medium, not the winding arithmetic, which is exact to input-constant precision.
